Looking at this issue, the problem is in the JSON schema to OpenAPI schema conversion used by the Google/Vertex providers. When `z.record(z.string())` is used, zod generates a JSON schema with `propertyNames`/`additionalProperties` that isn't handled correctly by the converter, causing the property to become `undefined` in the generated OpenAPI schema sent to Vertex AI.

The `@ai-sdk/google-vertex` package reuses the Google Generative AI model implementation from `@ai-sdk/google`, so the fix belongs in the `google` package's schema conversion logic (which then also fixes Vertex).

Files that need to be edited:

```
packages/google/src/convert-json-schema-to-openapi-schema.ts
packages/google/src/convert-json-schema-to-openapi-schema.test.ts
.changeset/fix-vertex-record-schema.md
```

**Explanation:**

1. **`packages/google/src/convert-json-schema-to-openapi-schema.ts`** — This is the core file containing the `convertJsonSchemaToOpenApiSchema` logic that transforms JSON schemas (produced from zod schemas like `z.record(z.string())`) into the OpenAPI schema format Google/Vertex expects. The fix needs to properly handle record schemas (e.g., `propertyNames` / `additionalProperties` handling) so the property doesn't get dropped/turned into `undefined`.

2. **`packages/google/src/convert-json-schema-to-openapi-schema.test.ts`** — The existing test file for the conversion function, where a test case for `z.record(z.string())` (record/additionalProperties schemas) should be added to verify the fix and prevent regressions.

3. **`.changeset/fix-vertex-record-schema.md`** — A new changeset file (following the repo's changeset convention) documenting the patch fix for `@ai-sdk/google` and `@ai-sdk/google-vertex`, since the repository requires changesets for releases.
